kpis.title: Gate handling time
kpis.measurement: Measure routine arrival creation to final approved or denied gate decision during representative peak periods; report p50 and p95.
kpis.threshold: Pilot target: p95 <= 45 seconds for routine arrivals and zero authorization bypasses.

kpis.title: Visitor approval latency
kpis.measurement: Measure visitor approval request creation to resident approval or denial for reachable current occupants.
kpis.threshold: Pilot target: p95 <= 60 seconds for reachable occupants; stale or unauthorized occupants must never receive authority.

kpis.title: Resident activation
kpis.measurement: Measure invited pilot households that complete sign-in and active-property setup within seven days of invitation.
kpis.threshold: Pilot target: >= 80% activation within seven days, with unresolved activation failures dispositioned.

kpis.title: Maintenance collection rate
kpis.measurement: Measure amount collected against pilot-period amount due using Aaraagate accounting truth, excluding approved waivers or formally deferred balances.
kpis.threshold: Pilot target: >= 90% collection by the agreed pilot cut-off, or documented society-approved exception.

kpis.title: Payment failure rate
kpis.measurement: Measure attempted provider-backed payments that end failed or unresolved, separately identifying provider, user and reconciliation causes.
kpis.threshold: Pilot target: <= 2% unexplained or provider-attributable failure rate after reconciliation; zero client-trusted success.

kpis.title: Helpdesk SLA attainment
kpis.measurement: Measure pilot helpdesk tickets resolved or formally escalated within their configured SLA/TAT.
kpis.threshold: Pilot target: >= 90% SLA attainment and every breach has an owner and disposition.

kpis.title: Amenity booking completion
kpis.measurement: Measure valid booking attempts that reach confirmed or waitlisted outcomes without technical failure, excluding policy/capacity rejections.
kpis.threshold: Pilot target: >= 95% technically successful valid attempts; zero cross-property booking leakage.

kpis.title: Crash-free sessions
kpis.measurement: Measure Resident and Guard crash-free session percentage on representative pilot devices using the selected monitoring provider.
kpis.threshold: Pilot target: >= 99.5% crash-free sessions for both Resident and Guard during the acceptance window.

kpis.title: Support burden
kpis.measurement: Track pilot support incidents per active household and classify product defect, training, policy and provider causes.
kpis.threshold: Pilot target: <= 0.25 support incidents per active household per week and zero unresolved Sev-1/Sev-2 blockers.
